newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid general stock index closes at new high.
newsitem.headline: Madrid general stock index closes at new high.

text.p: Madrid's general stock index ended at a new high on Friday --although the Ibex ended flat-- recouping earlier losses after firmness on Wall Street and after the Ibex futures expiry, dealers said.
The general index rose 0.45 points, 0.09 percent, to 491.16 and the Ibex shed 1.16 points, 0.02 percent, to 5,628.14.
Telefonica up 30 pesetas to 3,595, a new closing high, after it signed a global alliance with BT and MCI, which got a positive reception from analysts worldwide.
Telefonica took up most of the attention today, with near seven million shares changing hands.
Repsol ended at a new all-time high, rising 30 pesetas to 6,300 amid a last privatisation. The retail tranche is so far 30 times oversubscribed.
Dealers were optimistic about the chances of further gains medium term, but they said the market needed to consolidate.
"There's some nervousness at these levels and the market hasn't really had a chance to draw breath," said one dealer.
Focus will be on corporate results next week with banks Santander -which ended flat at 9,990- and BCH -which gained 25 pesetas to 4,020- reporting first quarter earnings.
